Definition: from G2596 and G1210; to tie down, i.e. bandage (a wound):--bind up.
BiblicalUsage: The Samaritan bound up the wounded man's wounds, pouring in oil and wine before he set him on his own beast.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe mercy does not walk past, it stops and binds up.
